message.content: {"choice":4,"reason":"Продажа в кредит конвертирует товар в вексель, который прибавится к cash уже после девальвации в раунде 6, что выгоднее прямой продажи."}
message.reasoning_content:
Round 5 market, cash tiny. Best to sell now at high price? Sold counter 0, price 12 per unit (no tax). But cash gets devalued in round 6 anyway (cash*0.62). Selling for cash now means devaluation; sell_credit gives promissory paid in round 6 (added after devaluation) — but promissory in round 6 market... round 6 cash floor rule applies at start of round 6, promissory added then. Round 6 sell_credit not repaid, but round 5 sell_credit is repaid at start of round 6, safe.

Sell 2 credit = 27.5 promissory, better than 24 cash (which devalues to ~14.9). Yes, choice 4.
